title: Record Heatwave Hits Europe with Fatalities and School Closures
summary: Europe is experiencing its hottest year on record as a persistent heat dome traps hot air over the continent. Authorities have issued alerts, schools are closing, and dozens of deaths have been reported.
summary_points: Meteorologists describe a 'heat dome' trapping rising temperatures across western and central Europe.
